findings.evidence: Lines 46–56 conclude an eventual statement from `hF`, `hdeg`, and `hcard` at `x₀`, but lines 51–52 demand `∀ x, StrictMono (r x)` and `∀ x, Set.range (r x) = ...`; the proof uses these only at `x₀` and at the filtered nearby `x`. Line 85 inherits exactly the same excessive scope.
findings.fix: Require strict monotonicity and root enumeration at `x₀` together with their eventual validity in `𝓝 x₀` (or package both properties as eventual hypotheses), and use those eventual facts in the filtered proof.
findings.issue: `eventually_ordered_roots_close_of_card_aroots_le` and line 85's `continuousAt_ordered_root_of_card_aroots_le` require `hr` and `hroots` for every `x : B`, although their hypotheses and conclusions are local at `x₀`. This excludes disconnected families whose remote components have a different number of real roots.

summary: The two point-local root-continuity APIs unnecessarily require a global enumeration, preventing their use when other components have different root counts.
